title: Matt Gaetz constituent describes similar psionic human cargo

tellings.quote: you got Matt Gates for example, he I don't know if you know about this. He was doing a Twitter space and he's telling about, you know, one of his constituents who who came into his office saying something very similar.

related.note: Both are about someone coming into Matt Gaetz's office to tell him about a hidden program. This telling says the visitor described psionic human cargo; the story says hybrid breeding.

plain: A constituent of the congressman Matt Gaetz is said to have come into his office and described something very like other accounts of people with psychic abilities being carried as cargo. Michels tells this as something Gaetz recounted on a live Twitter audio chat, and he raises it as a sign that such stories reach elected officials from more than one direction.
